metadata.description: Baseline PRULink InvestGrowth (SP) SRS scenario proving the supported initial single-premium corridor without Direct Income payouts.

policyInput.name: Golden PRULink InvestGrowth (SP) (SGD-OPEN-ENDED-SRS)
catalogWarnings: PRULink InvestGrowth (SP) is cataloged as a supported V1 product. The parser captures the published initial single-premium charge, premium-event assurance-charge path for initial and standard top-up premiums, the published S$2,000 one-off top-up minimum, the published S$1,000 one-off withdrawal minimum and residual-account floor, the current-state death benefit as the higher of policy value or 110% of total premiums plus top-ups less withdrawals, and cash-corridor Direct Income support through the manual distribution-mode kernel, while e-top-up treatment, broader withdrawal administration, fund-switching, and cash Direct Income payout history in death-benefit calculations remain outside the current engine.
This SRS-funded variant uses the published 3% premium-charge and 1.5% premium-event assurance-charge path.
This open-ended product uses the no-MIP basis; the review horizon is chosen in the policy seed rather than by product contract.

The current-state death benefit is modeled as the higher of policy value or 110% of total premiums plus top-ups less withdrawals; the published S$2,000 one-off top-up minimum plus the published S$1,000 one-off withdrawal minimum and residual-account floor are also executable, while active cash Direct Income payout history still needs manual review.
Open-ended products use a default 20-year review horizon in V1; adjust the horizon if you want a different analysis window.
Enter the one-time gross initial single premium lump sum in Policy Details if you want the upfront single-premium deduction to seed the starting policy value honestly.
Terminal-illness claim handling, death-benefit exclusions, and cash Direct Income payout history remain informational only beyond the modeled current ordinary death-benefit estimate.
Single-premium principal tracking remains informational only in V1.
e-top-up reduced premium-charge and assurance-charge treatment remains informational only.
Broader withdrawal administration and fund-switching mechanics remain informational only.
Direct Income option mechanics remain informational only.
